name: reqlint-smollm3-3b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 65536). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.075 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-01. CAVEAT: the base prints 0.0 in every column because it never emits the required JSON, so the gap mixes task-format compliance with detection skill; two of the four rows are the author's own synthetic generator (one saturated at 1.0) and the real-requirements set is small. Narrow task model (English requirements linting), not a general-generation contender.

benchmarks.name: Defect detection micro-F1, real requirements
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | Real | Synthetic, unseen | Synthetic, seen | Rewrite exact, unseen |': HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B prints 0.0 in all four columns - the base never emits the required JSON, so the gap measures task-format compliance as much as detection ability. Real set = hand-labelled requirements from public-domain documents (jgalego/reqlint-real, small). LoRA r=16 merged into SmolLM3-3B.

benchmarks.name: Defect detection micro-F1, synthetic unseen
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 0.0. Synthetic, unseen = maritime/medical domains with defect words that never appear in training; still generated by the author's own generator.

benchmarks.name: Defect detection micro-F1, synthetic seen
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 0.0. Same domains and word lists as training - saturated, not informative. A regex rules baseline scores 0.996 here.

benchmarks.name: Rewrite exact match, unseen
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 0.0. Exact-string match on EARS rewrites from the synthetic unseen set.
